name: temp_file_limit
description: Limits the total size of all temporary files used by each database process.
symptoms: Transaction cancellation on temp file overflow
Unexpected query failures during large sorts or hashes
High disk I/O from uncontrolled temp file growth
Disk space exhaustion on shared temporary storage
tuning_tips: Set to a realistic per-process disk quota based on available temporary storage and workload patterns; monitor pg_stat_database.temp_files and temp_bytes to inform sizing; leave as -1 (unlimited) only if disk space is abundant and usage is trusted.
